title: Analytics
summary: Analytics is the systematic computational analysis of data used to discover, interpret, and communicate meaningful patterns, supporting decision-making across fields such as marketing, finance, and operations. It applies statistics, programming, and operations research to quantify performance and may include descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, prescriptive, and cognitive approaches. Organizations apply analytics to business data to describe past performance, predict future outcomes, and prescribe actions for improvement. Advanced analytics often employs machine learning techniques such as neural networks, decision trees, and clustering to build predictive models. Applications range from marketing optimization and web analytics to people analytics, which uses behavioral data to inform workforce management and human resource decisions.

mechanisms.title: Pattern discovery and interpretation
mechanisms.explanation: Analytics employs statistical and computational methods to detect meaningful patterns within data, transforming raw information into interpretable insights about past performance or future trends.

mechanisms.title: Decision-support application
mechanisms.explanation: Derived patterns are applied toward effective decision-making, enabling organizations to describe, predict, and improve performance in areas such as marketing, finance, and workforce management.
